info.title: snaplab API
info.summary: Turn any URL or HTML into a screenshot, a PDF, or a social image.
info.description: snaplab renders web pages with a real headless Chromium and hands you the bytes. - `POST|GET /api/render` — URL **or** raw HTML → PNG / JPEG / WebP / AVIF / PDF, viewport or full page, retina, dark mode, element clipping. - `POST|GET /api/render/image` — HTML (or a `{{ template }}` + `data`) → a fixed-size image. The Open Graph card path. - `POST /api/render/preview` — unauthenticated, rate-limited demo render. - `POST /api/tools/*` — key-less public tools, 20 renders/day/IP, always answered with a hosted URL. - `/mcp` — a stateless Streamable-HTTP MCP server exposing `screenshot`, `pdf`, `html_to_image` and `usage`. ## Authentication Every endpoint except `/api/health`, `/api/render/preview` and `/api/tools/*` needs an API key. Keys look like `sk_…` and are created in the dashboard or through `POST /api/keys`. 1. `Authorization: Bearer sk_…` — the header form, accepted everywhere. 2. Signed query parameters — `GET /api/render` and `GET /api/render/image` only. See below. 3. The browser session cookie, for the dashboard itself. ### Signed URLs Putting a raw key in an `` leaks it. Sign the URL instead: append `keyId` (the API key's id) and `sig=hex(HMAC_SHA256(signing_secret, canonical))`, optionally with an `expires` Unix timestamp. The canonical string is every query pair except `sig`, sorted by name then value and joined with `&`. The per-key signing secret and a URL builder live in the dashboard under Keys. ## Options Options are camelCase and identical between the JSON body and the query string. In a query string, booleans are `true`/`1` and `false`/`0`, `hideSelectors` is a comma-separated list, and PDF options take either the dotted form (`pdf.format=A4`) or the flat alias (`pdfFormat=A4`). ## Caching and quota Identical options are served from a shared cache for 24h. **Cache hits and failed renders do not count against your quota** — only fresh, successful renders do. Renders carry `X-Snaplab-Cache`, `X-Snaplab-Duration-Ms`, `X-Snaplab-Fingerprint` and `X-Snaplab-Quota-Remaining`. Pass `cache: false` to force a fresh render. ## Errors Errors are JSON: `{"error":"…","code":"…"}`. Messages are for humans; codes are stable. | Status | Code | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | 400 | — | A parameter is missing, malformed, out of range, or the target is a private/blocked address. | | 401 | `unauthorized` | Missing, unknown or revoked API key; or a bad signature. | | 402 | `payment_required` | The subscription is past due. | | 422 | `selector_not_found` | The page rendered but `selector` matched nothing. | | 429 | `quota_exceeded` | The monthly render allowance is used up. | | 429 | — | Too many requests per minute for your plan. | | 502 | `upstream` | The target site was unreachable. | | 503 | `capacity` / `not_ready` | The render queue is saturated, or the browsers are still starting. Retry shortly. | | 504 | `timeout` | The page did not finish in time. | ## Plans | Plan | Renders / month | Price | Rate | Concurrency | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | free | 100 | $0 | 30/min | 1 | | starter | 2,000 | $9 | 120/min | 3 | | pro | 10,000 | $29 | 300/min | 5 | | business | 40,000 | $79 | 600/min | 10 |

post.description: The main endpoint. Give it a `url` **or** inline `html`/`template` and it answers with the bytes — or, with `responseType: "json"`, a hosted URL.

X-Snaplab-Cache.description: Whether the bytes came from the cache. Hits are free.

400.description: Invalid options, or a target that resolves to a private/blocked address.

401.description: Missing or invalid API key / signature.

422.description: The render can never succeed as written (`selector_not_found`).

get.summary: Render a URL or HTML (query form)
get.description: Every option as a query parameter, so a render can sit in an ``. Accepts a bearer key or a signed URL (`keyId` + `sig`).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Absolute http(s) URL. Provide this or `html`/`template`.

parameters.name: html
parameters.description: URL-encoded HTML to render instead of navigating.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: JSON object (URL-encoded) with values for the template.

parameters.name: waitUntil
parameters.description: Navigation wait condition. Default "auto": waits for load, then for the network to be quiet for 150ms, capped at 400ms. "networkidle" is the full wait and costs ~0.5s more.

parameters.name: waitForSelector
parameters.description: Wait for this selector before capturing.

parameters.name: scrollY
parameters.description: Scroll down first, to trigger lazy loading.

parameters.name: darkMode
parameters.description: `true`/`force` emulate `prefers-color-scheme: dark` AND turn on Chromium's auto dark mode, so a site with no dark theme still comes back dark (a site that has one is left alone). `prefers` is the media query only.

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: Set `false` to force a fresh render.

parameters.name: responseType
parameters.description: `json` answers with a hosted URL instead of bytes.

parameters.name: pdf.preferCSSPageSize
parameters.description: Honour the page's `@page size`. Flat alias: `pdfPreferCSSPageSize`.

parameters.name: pdf.margin
parameters.description: One CSS length applied to all four sides. Per-side: `pdf.margin.top` … or `pdfMarginTop` ….

parameters.name: pdf.headerTemplate
parameters.description: HTML drawn at the top of every page. Flat alias: `pdfHeaderTemplate`.

parameters.name: pdf.footerTemplate
parameters.description: HTML drawn at the bottom of every page, or a preset name (`@pageNumbers`, `@pageNumbersUrl`). Setting it turns `displayHeaderFooter` on. Flat alias: `pdfFooterTemplate`.

parameters.name: pdf.displayHeaderFooter
parameters.description: Draw the running header/footer. Inferred from the templates. Flat alias: `pdfDisplayHeaderFooter`.

parameters.name: pdf.media
parameters.description: Stylesheet the paper is printed under. Default `print`. Case-insensitive. Flat alias: `pdfMedia`.

parameters.name: pdf.tagged
parameters.description: Emit a tagged (accessible) PDF. Flat alias: `pdfTagged`.

parameters.name: pdf.outline
parameters.description: Embed a document outline (bookmarks). Flat alias: `pdfOutline`.

parameters.name: pdf.width
parameters.description: Exact paper width as a CSS length; replaces `pdf.format` and needs `pdf.height` too. Flat alias: `pdfWidth`.

parameters.name: pdf.height
parameters.description: Exact paper height as a CSS length. Flat alias: `pdfHeight`.

parameters.name: pdf.omitBackground
parameters.description: Drop background colours and images. Flat alias: `pdfOmitBackground`.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Suggested download name, sanitised — sets `content-disposition` on the response.

parameters.name: keyId
parameters.description: API key id, for a signed URL. Send with `sig`.

parameters.name: sig
parameters.description: `hex(HMAC_SHA256(signingSecret, canonicalQuery))` over every pair except `sig`, sorted by name then value.

parameters.name: expires
parameters.description: Optional Unix-seconds expiry, included in the signed canonical string.

get.summary: The current account, plan and usage

billingConfigured.description: False when Stripe isn't configured on this deployment.

webhookUrl.description: Account-default capture callback, used when a request names none.

webhookSecret.description: Masked to the last four characters (`****1234`). The real secret is never returned.

patch.description: Either field may be sent on its own; `null` or `""` clears it. Used by any capture that does not carry its own `webhookUrl`.

webhookUrl.description: `https://` only; private, loopback and metadata addresses are refused.

webhookSecret.description: Signs every callback that uses this URL.
Masked to the last four characters.

400.description: Nothing to update, or a webhook field that failed validation.

interval.description: Billing interval. Yearly is ten months' price for twelve; omit for monthly.

503.description: Billing is not configured on this deployment (`billing_not_configured`).

post.description: Stripe calls this. The raw body is verified against `Stripe-Signature`; it is not part of the public API.

get.summary: Liveness, browser readiness and render statistics

ready.description: At least one browser can render.

stats.description: Queue depth, pool state, cache counters.

bearerAuth.description: Send the key as `Authorization: Bearer sk_…`. This is also how the MCP server at `/mcp` authenticates.

signedKeyId.name: keyId
signedKeyId.description: Signed-URL auth (GET renders only): the API key's **id**, not its secret. Pair with `sig`.

signedSignature.name: sig
signedSignature.description: `hex(HMAC_SHA256(signingSecret, canonical))`, where canonical is every query pair except `sig`, sorted by name then value and joined with `&`. Add `expires` (Unix seconds) to time-limit the URL.

RenderOptions.description: Exactly one of `url` or `html`/`template` must be given.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to capture. Private, loopback, link-local and metadata addresses are refused.

html.description: Raw HTML rendered instead of navigating. Subresources are still SSRF-filtered.

template.description: HTML with `{{ path.to.value }}` placeholders, substituted from `data` and HTML-escaped.

data.description: Values for `template` (or for `html`, when no template is given).

css.description: Stylesheet injected into `<head>` before load. html/template mode only.

googleFonts.description: Comma-separated Google Fonts families, e.g. `Inter,Playfair Display` (max 6).

fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable document. Ignored when `selector` is set.

selector.description: Capture just this element. PDFs stay vector/selectable.

waitUntil.description: "auto" waits for load, then for the network to be quiet for 150ms, capped at 400ms. "networkidle" is the full Playwright wait and costs ~0.5s more.

waitForSelector.description: Wait (up to 10s) for this selector before capturing.

scrollY.description: Scroll down this many pixels first (triggers lazy loading).

hideSelectors.description: Elements to hide before capturing. Comma-separated in a query string.

darkMode.description: `true` (= `"force"`) emulates `prefers-color-scheme: dark` AND turns on Chromium's auto dark mode, so a page with no dark theme comes back dark; a page that has one is left alone. `"prefers"` is the media query only.

dismissBanners.description: Hide known cookie/consent/chat banners with a curated stylesheet.

blockAds.description: Abort requests to known ad, analytics and session-replay hosts.

expires.description: Unix seconds. Omit for a session cookie.

cookies.description: Per-request cookies. Renders with cookies are never cached or shared.

preferCSSPageSize.description: Honour the page's own `@page size` rule instead of `format`.

headerTemplate.description: HTML drawn at the top of every page, inside the top margin. It inherits none of the document's CSS, so set `font-size` explicitly and add your own side padding. Any element carrying the classes `pageNumber`, `totalPages`, `date`, `title` or `url` is filled in by Chromium.

footerTemplate.description: Same as `headerTemplate`, at the bottom of every page. Also accepts a built-in preset name: `@pageNumbers` (centred “Page N of M”) or `@pageNumbersUrl` (page numbers left, document URL right).

displayHeaderFooter.description: Draw the running header and footer. Defaults to `true` as soon as either template is set; pass `false` to suppress both.

pageRanges.description: Sheets to keep, in print-dialog syntax — `1-3`, `1,4,7-9`. Default: every page.

media.description: Which stylesheet the paper is printed under. `print` honours the document's own print CSS (`@media print` rules, page breaks, hidden nav); `screen` keeps the on-screen look. Screenshots are always screen media.

tagged.description: Emit a tagged (accessible) PDF with structure tags for screen readers.

outline.description: Embed a document outline (PDF bookmarks) built from the page's headings.

width.description: Exact paper width as a CSS length. Replaces `format`; ignored unless `height` is set too.

height.description: Exact paper height as a CSS length.

omitBackground.description: Drop background colours and images. The same knob as `printBackground: false`, and it wins over it.

filename.description: Suggested download name, sanitised. Sets `content-disposition: inline; filename="…"` on the returned bytes and on the hosted `/i/c/{id}` file (`?download=1` there makes it an `attachment`). Include the extension you want — it is used verbatim.

cache.description: Set false to force a fresh render.

responseType.description: `binary` streams the bytes; `json` stores the render and answers with a hosted URL.

ImageOptions.description: Fixed-canvas rendering for social/OG cards. Requires `html` or `template`.

template.description: HTML with `{{ placeholders }}`, substituted from `data` and HTML-escaped.

darkMode.description: `true`/`"force"` darken the card even without a dark theme; `"prefers"` is the media query only.

HostedRender.description: Answer for `responseType: "json"` — the render is stored and served from a public, immutable URL.

webhook.description: Only on `GET /api/captures/{id}`, and only when a callback was set.

code.description: Stable machine code, when one applies.

CaptureRequest.description: Every `RenderOptions` field, plus the optional callback. Omitted webhook fields fall back to the account defaults set with `PATCH /api/me`.

webhookUrl.description: `https://` URL POSTed once the capture reaches `completed` or `failed`. Private, loopback, link-local and metadata addresses are refused with a 400.

webhookSecret.description: Signs the callback: `x-snaplab-signature: sha256=hex(HMAC_SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + rawBody))`. Never returned by the API.

WebhookDelivery.description: One delivery attempt of a capture callback. Attempts run at 0s, 30s, 5min and 30min; after the fourth the row is `gave_up`.

lastStatusCode.description: HTTP status of the last attempt; null if the request never completed.

CaptureWebhook.description: Present on `GET /api/captures/{id}` only when a callback was set.

WebhookPayload.description: The JSON body snaplab POSTs to `webhookUrl`. Headers: `content-type: application/json`, `user-agent: snaplab-webhooks/1`, `x-snaplab-event`, `x-snaplab-delivery`, `x-snaplab-timestamp` and, when a secret is set, `x-snaplab-signature`. Only a 2xx counts as delivered; a 3xx is never followed.
